messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High queue depth on inference-cluster-7; model-family aurora-8x > 90th percentile latency spike. Alert_id=inc-2161234567 runbook: <https://runbooks.internal/r/inc-2161234567>
Maria G.: I'm on it. Looking at qps and active requests. Seeing a big tail from aurora-8x standard and streaming sessions.
Ajay K.: @Maria G. want me to take handoff? I'm primary oncall for this window.
Maria G.: yep, handoff to @Ajay K. please. I can keep watching logs for errors.
Ajay K.: taking. Quick impact summary: 10% error rate increase for hosted customers sending long-context streaming; token backlog climbing. Rolling back nothing yet.
Lex R.: We should consider immediate targeted RPM reduction for aurora-8x alpha and beta variants. Keep the rest untouched.
Ajay K.: Agreed. Plan: 1) apply rate limit change profile aurora-surgical-33pct to aurora-8x-family in prod region-us-east. 2) disable streaming for aurora-8x-alpha temporarily (switch to non-streaming fallback). 3) notify Support and mark mitigation in incident board.
Pete S.: If we're lowering RPM, also adjust client-facing quota to avoid 429 thrash. Suggest set RPM->300 and TPM->12k for alpha, beta for next 30m.
Ajay K.: Copy. Executing change now.
Ajay K.: `/ops rate-limit update --family aurora-8x --profile aurora-surgical-33pct --region us-east --apply`
incident-bot: Change accepted, job id rl-2161234572 queued.
Ajay K.: `/ops quota patch --family aurora-8x-alpha --rpm 300 --tpm 12000 --ttl 30m`
incident-bot: Quota change applied: qid=q-2161234578
Ajay K.: `/ops feature toggle --family aurora-8x-alpha --feature streaming --state off --reason "mitigation: backlog"`
incident-bot: Feature toggle recorded: ft-2161234581
Maria G.: Observability: latency p95 dropped from 1.4s to 0.9s in 90s, queue depth decreasing.
Lex R.: Nice. Any customer-facing impact? Support?
Cassandra: Support note: We have two customers with streaming sessions in the affected family; escalation policy engaged. We'll notify them that streaming will degrade and non-streaming fallback is enforced. Templates ready.
Ajay K.: Posting to #customer-signal: "We're applying temporary rate limits and disabling streaming for aurora-8x variants due to increased backend queuing. This is targeted; we'll roll back when stable." Will post ETA 30m.
Pete S.: Keep an eye on retry storms — add 10s jitter in the proxy for 429s (soft backoff) if possible.
Ajay K.: Done: `/ops proxy config set --region us-east --on-429 backoff:10s+jitter` -> job px-2161234590
Maria G.: No new elevated errors; error rate back to baseline. Continued monitoring.
Lex R.: Let's keep these changes for 45m then re-evaluate. If stable, we'll stage rollback to 15min ramp.
Ajay K.: Logged mitigation steps in incident ticket INC-2161234567. Assigning follow-up to @Lex R. for postmortem action items: better per-family graceful degradation docs and a test harness for streaming fallbacks.
oncall-bot: Handoff: Ajay K. -> Lex R. in 35m. // Reminder set.
Ajay K.: Closing loop: everything looks healthy. Reenable streaming and restore quotas on 2161234847 unless we see regression.
Maria G.: tl;dr: target throttling + streaming off for aurora-8x-alpha/beta; metrics improved; support notified; rollback plan in place.
Cassandra: I'll send customers an update now. Template: "We've applied temporary rate limits and disabled streaming for the aurora-8x family in us-east to protect latency for all users. Expected restoration in ~45 minutes. We'll keep you updated."
Lex R.: Thanks all. Adding this to postmortem board and tagging infra/serving for kernel selection review.
incident-bot: Incident mitigations recorded in INC-2161234567. Runbook link: <https://runbooks.internal/r/inc-2161234567/mitigations>
Ajay K.: marking thread resolved for immediate paging; will reopen if metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
